Package com.eventlottery.model

Class GuestList

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.GuestList
public class GuestList extends Object
Manages the list of attendees for a specific event. Handles attendee registration, status tracking, and capacity limits. Automatically synchronizes changes with Firebase Firestore.
